items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Sam Moore and Chris Kelly had a crowd of all the kids right there. And they went in and they put a package on.

ctx.x: Now, who would Chris play for? What kind of people? Hmm? What kind of places would Chris play in? Who would he play for? Who would he play for? Oh, he'd go to Santa Sons and Copper Riven Hall and E. Codd Hall. He'd go to high and more around. He'd go to high and more. Was Chris a flashy dresser or did he dress for playing?

Yeah, he was a tractor. Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly. Sam Moore and Chris Kelly had a crowd of all the kids right there. And they went in and they put a package on. Well, they're using one cornet long days or two. Huh?
How many cornets would they use? One or two? One. One.
